question:
In the following diagram, the circle stands for 'teachers', the rectangle stands for 'part-time workers', and the triangle stands for 'online educators'. The numbers given in the different segments represent the number of persons of that category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92b4a82bce863208fa728c1365e5cf02262482eeca5cca87d45bfc497d20458b.png] 

How many teachers are online educators and also part-time workers?
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given representation of segments is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c34e2c1f531cd38c4c564f24498f11b1b5163354f0774670643cf374370c0ac5.png] 

∴ Here, '19' teachers are online educators and also part-time workers.

Hence, the correct answer is **"19".**
